title: Tuning is individual
summary: Tuning to notes is unnecessary; players differ, Idris Muhammad tunes differently, and a good drummer makes the sound.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
